summary: A model cannot tell instructions from data. You attack your own assistant in a scratch table: a poisoned page is retrieved and its sentence lands in the prompt, a worst-case stand-in writer obeys it, an output check blocks the link, and a staff-only secret never reaches a customer's prompt because of the role filter. You list every place where outside text enters your system.
goal: Attack your own assistant with one injection.

items.text: Run injection_demo.py and match the four parts
Write your own injection into the poisoned page and predict whether the scan and the output check catch it
Remove the output check and see what the customer sees and which layers are left
Run the scan over your own knowledge base
Write the attack surface: every place where outside text enters, and who can write there
Play the Injection Check game to the end and see your score
